# Gen 9 Random Battle — full match, exactly as the client receives it off the socket.
#
# Every line shape in here was verified against the real simulator shipped in
# node_modules/pokemon-showdown (see the `[from] ` spacing, the `move: `/`ability: `
# effect prefixes, the `NN/100` foe HP under HP Percentage Mod, and the nickname/
# species split on forme'd Pokemon such as Rotom-Wash -> "Rotom").
#
# Frames are separated by the `>roomid` line, the way Showdown actually chunks them.
# Lines starting with `#` are fixture comments and are stripped before feeding.
#
# Three deliberate departures from a stock ladder game, all required to exercise
# parser branches that are otherwise never reached:
#   * a team-preview block (`|clearpoke|`/`|poke|`/`|teampreview`) — Gen 9 Random
#     Battle does not send one, but `inject.js` has a `poke` case to cover.
#   * nicknames on two foe Pokemon ("Éclair♪", "Big Nap:Zzz") — randbats never
#     nicknames, but the parser keys everything off the nickname so it must hold up.
#     Showdown strips `|` from nicknames (it is the protocol delimiter), so the
#     awkward characters here are the ones that can genuinely occur.
#   * the Choice Specs knocked off Rotom-Wash on turn 28. Nothing else in the log
#     removes a Choice item, and the choice-lock counter has to be seen resetting
#     mid-stint rather than only on a switch. Rotom's own earlier turns (Will-O-Wisp
#     then Hydro Pump, turns 11-12) are not consistent with having held it all game;
#     the line is here for the `|-enditem|` branch, not for the set.
#
# p1 AlphaTester    Skarmory L80 / Weavile L79 / Rotom-Wash L82 /
#                   Dragonite L74 / Great Tusk L77 / Corviknight L80
# p2 RandomLadderer Furret L94 "Éclair♪" / Snorlax L82 "Big Nap:Zzz" / Gyarados L79 /
#                   Palafin L77 / Oricorio-Pom-Pom L82 "Oricorio" / Zoroark-Hisui L80 "Zoroark"
|updateuser| AlphaTester|1|265|{"blockChallenges":false,"blockPMs":false,"ignoreTickets":false}
>battle-gen9randombattle-2312345678

|rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon
